競合(相手の資料に記載)

companies.name: ハーバード・バイオサイエンス

relations.text: CRO顧客の一社にラボコープを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Labcorp among its CRO customers

source.label: Harvard Bioscience 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our CRO customers include Charles River Laboratories, Labcorp and Wuxi AppTec.

relations.text: 2023年にラボコープの臨床開発事業から分離・独立
relations.text_en: Spun off from Labcorp's CRO business in 2023

source.label: Fortrea 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Pursuant to the Separation and Distribution Agreement, Labcorp agreed to spin-off its CRO business into Fortrea, a standalone, publicly traded company.

relations.text: 傘下バイオリファレンスの検査事業をラボコープに2度売却
relations.text_en: Sold BioReference testing assets to Labcorp in 2024 and 2025

source.label: OPKO Health 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On September 15, 2025, we consummated the sale of certain assets of BioReference to Labcorp (the "Oncology Transaction")

relations.text: 肝疾患診断技術NIS4をラボコープにライセンス
relations.text_en: Licenses its NIS4 liver diagnostic technology to Labcorp

source.label: Genfit 20-F(2024年度)
source.quote: Our NIS4® technology and its improvements are licensed to two partners, both to Labcorp to allow them to deploy an LDT powered by NIS4® technology

relations.text: 前立腺がん検査Proclarixの米国独占権をラボコープに供与
relations.text_en: Granted Labcorp exclusive U.S. rights to the Proclarix test

source.label: Onconetix S-1(2026年4月)
source.quote: the development and commercialization of Proclarix in the United States is being pursued by Labcorp, pursuant to an exclusive license agreement

relations.text: 出生前検査(NIPT)の競合にラボコープを挙げる

source.label: Natera 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our competitors in the NIPT space include Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings, or Labcorp;

relations.text: 出生前検査の主な競合にラボコープを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Labcorp among its main prenatal competitors

source.label: BillionToOne 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In the prenatal market, our main competitors offering NIPTs include Illumina, through its subsidiary Verinata, Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings (Labcorp)

relations.text: ラボコープの4Kscore検査が自社検査と競合
relations.text_en: Labcorp's 4Kscore test competes with its Confirm mdx test

source.label: MDxHealth 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: The 4Kscore test, offered by Labcorp, and the MPS2 test offered by Lynx Dx, each competes with the Confirm mdx test.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
